hypothesis: A robot-self-excluding RGB-D rigid-following verifier preserves and recognizes real grasps that the VLM leaves unknown, allowing the next subgoal.
registered_grasp_requirements: Current target identified; no explicit non-enclosure/non-following, slip or collision claim
Actual nonempty pending closed hand, independently for both arms when applicable
At least 8 stable forward/backward RGB-D feature matches per lift; reject known robot-link visual boxes at actual finger positions
At least 80 percent hand-relative residual <3mm and world target-vs-hand displacement residual <4mm
At least two consecutive independently measured lift intervals, cumulative translation >=15mm and upward >=12mm
Original 9-image observer retained; raw claims preserved, never rewrite null as true
stop: Unknown potentially loaded grasp: hold without releasing
limitations: Known development start, assisted grasp mode, version3.9.1; not an independent challenge success-rate test. Old B7 has no per-frame robot self boxes, so those single-pair findings remain diagnostic and cannot authorize deployment.
